highlights.title: Add a computer one step at a time
highlights.line: Adding a computer to Kosmos+ now shows what it costs before you pay and notices your payment by itself, and no longer asks you to name it.

highlights.title: Undo covers Codex and Antigravity agents
highlights.line: With undo on, Codex and Antigravity file tool edits now keep a copy, and a project's Files page usually names the agent that made them.

highlights.title: A monthly AI cap for families
highlights.line: Parents can now set a monthly cap on a child's Claude use in the family console; at the cap, Kosmos takes no new messages for its agents.

highlights.title: The restart check says what it could not check
highlights.line: When the Agents tab cannot tell whether some agents come back after a restart, it now says which ones, instead of leaving them out.

highlights.title: Idle agents hear which scheduled run is due
highlights.line: When a repeating task's run is due, an idle agent's reminder names that run and tells it how to record it.
